reviews.reason: The correction replaces browser history when a server total makes the requested page impossible, preserving the rest of the route filters. The query is keyed by the corrected page; simply deriving a displayed page count would leave the URL and request on the missing page. The guard requires a returned page.

Both Delete and Refresh Description explicitly await invalidateSettingsMcpInstancesAndTools on success. The helper invalidates the list prefixes (including paginated list keys) and the catalog. This source call chain, not an assertion about a success toast, is the counterexample.

Create and update share saveToolMutation.onSuccess: after closing the edit session it awaits invalidateSettingsMcpInstancesAndTools. That helper invalidates the instance, tool and catalog query prefixes, including page keys. A reopened detail is explicitly fetched with staleTime: 0, not restored as an editable cached value. The edit-session test asserts a second read and the outgoing updated draft; prefix invalidation is established by the helper source.
